issues.issue: Were the IAD's conclusions on H&C relief reasonable in light of the evidence, including the applicant's explanations for non-compliance?
issues.applicant_position: IAD ignored his efforts to meet conditions, his difficulties, and his trips to care for elderly parents; wife was excluded from hearing.
issues.respondent_position: Applicant had the onus and failed to show H&C factors; the IAD reasonably weighed his non-compliance and explanations.
issues.result_quote: The panel made no reviewable error in its weighing of the Applicant’s explanations
